verdict.rationale: The SES API v2 SendEmail docs show a Templated message type: SES replaces personalization tags with values you supply, which covers sending by template with variable payloads. Nothing in the pack shows API operations to create or update templates, and nothing shows template versioning. Community comments that you must 'handle the templating yourself' are general and do not concretely contradict the documented templated sends. Missing for 10: documented create/update template API, template versioning, explicit send-by-template-id reference, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, version, and update email templates through the API and trigger sends by template id with variable payloads

citations.quote: Templated – A message that contains personalization tags. When you send this type of email, Amazon SES API v2 automatically replaces the tags with values that you specify.
You can use the Amazon SES API v2 to send the following types of messages: Simple ... Raw ... Templated
